payload.title: The submodule mode constant ('160000') and a parser for git ls-tree -z records each exist in several modules and the lift adds one more of each; its new listings also decode with text=True, where workspace_view._listing reads bytes and calls os.fsdecode
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:659-672 (_base_tree_entries: a parser of ls-tree -r -z records that unpacks meta.split(' ') into three names, unchecked)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_evidence.py:1776-1812 (a third reader of ls-tree -z records (one path, not -r), with checks of the mode, type and id and named errors)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:664 (the ls-tree listing decoded as text (hermetic_git's default text=True))
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:689 (the ls-files listing, decoded the same way)
payload.rule_violated: One owner per concept: a git constant and the parse of a git record format are stated once and every reader reads through that owner
payload.notes: Registered by the D6-SEC findings clerk from the D6-SEC review round 1 (lens ssot), re-checked at head d460f7917 before registration; non-blocking at merge. Close condition: One module owns the gitlink mode and the ls-tree -z record parse (mode, type, id, path; a named error on a malformed record), and the lift, self_improvement, autonomy_evidence, workspace_view and main_anchor read through it; listings are read as bytes and decoded with os.fsdecode. Tests: a scan for the gitlink mode literal outside the owner; a malformed ls-tree record raises the named error through the lift's reader; the ARIA-LOW-973 test (a path named with the byte 0xff is refused by name).
